questions.q: What crop's overuse is highlighted as a root problem?
questions.why: The book identifies corn as the root of the problem.

questions.q: How many times has corn yield per acre increased since 1920?
questions.why: Yield rose from 20 to 180 bushels, a 9‑fold increase.

questions.q: Why has the organic label become less strict?
questions.why: The text says the processed food lobby lowered organic standards.

questions.q: What is one benefit of buying locally mentioned?
questions.why: Local buying cuts travel distance and fuel use.

questions.q: Which benefit does the book NOT list for local food?
questions.why: Higher prices are not presented as a benefit.
